systems.name: Learning
systems.description: The Learning system manages apprenticeship learning episodes, short courses, and associated data, including learners' personal details, courses, funding, progress, and history. It interacts with both internal databases and external services for data handling and event messaging.
capabilities: Integration with messaging systems like NServiceBus

systems.name: Courses
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship, framework, and standards data, as well as associated funding information. It supports importing, exporting, and external API interactions for additional data processing and notifications.
capabilities: Interface with external data download services
Fetch qualification sector subject area details
Interact with Skills England API for related information

systems.name: Campaign
systems.description: The Campaign system is responsible for managing and retrieving content such as articles, hubs, landing pages, banners, and menus, as well as providing tools for funding calculations and standards retrieval. It connects to Redis for caching, Azure Key Vault for secrets management, and uses external APIs and Azure Queue Storage for outbound communication.
capabilities: Manage and retrieve campaign articles, hubs, landing pages, banners, and menus
Perform funding calculations based on predefined criteria
Access and manage secrets with Azure Key Vault
Publish and consume messages via Azure Queue Storage

systems.name: Campaign
systems.description: This system handles campaign tracking data including interactions with emails, such as bounces, clicks, views, and unsubscribes. It also manages user signups and campaign metadata.

systems.name: Funding Apprenticeship Earnings
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship and short course earnings, payments, and related data, including installments, profiles, and historical records. It supports the creation, update, approval, and removal of learning data and communicates with external APIs and services for payment processing and data exchange.
capabilities: Create, update, and archive learning data
Track historical changes to learning profiles

systems.name: Payments DataLocks
systems.description: This system processes and manages data locks related to apprenticeship payments by handling events such as apprenticeship updates, status changes, and earning events. It includes multiple services for proxying, approvals, and processing data lock events and statuses.
capabilities: Handle provider and employer payment priorities
Approve or resolve data lock triage
Handle earning and incentive event matching

systems.name: Commitments
systems.description: Manages apprenticeship commitments, approvals, updates, transfers, and related processes for employers and training providers. The system integrates with various internal and external services for data storage, object storage, and event messaging.

systems.name: Reservations
systems.description: The system manages reservations of funds for training courses, including creating, viewing, updating, deleting, and validating reservations associated with employer accounts and legal entities. It integrates with SQL Server for data storage and utilizes Azure Service Bus for message-based communication.

systems.name: Employer Accounts
systems.description: Manages employer accounts, legal entities, agreements, PAYE schemes, invitations, and user roles within an employer context. Supports data access, notifications, and apprenticeship levy integration.

systems.name: Reservations
systems.description: The system facilitates managing employer and provider reservations, including operations related to funding rules and reservations for training courses. It integrates with external services such as Redis Cache and Commitments API.

systems.name: Das Apim Endpoints
systems.description: The system provides APIs and commands to manage applications, qualifications, organizations, courses, events, notifications, and users. It integrates with various internal and external APIs for functionality such as caching, authentication, accounts, qualifications, and events.

systems.name: Apprentice Progress
systems.description: This system manages apprentices' progress, including tasks, notifications, and knowledge, skill, and behavior updates. It supports functionality to add, update, and monitor apprenticeship-related data.

systems.name: Find Apprenticeship
systems.description: The system manages saved apprenticeship searches and allows users to query apprenticeship vacancies based on various attributes. It also handles the creation, update, and deletion of saved searches.

systems.name: Provider Commitments
systems.description: The system manages provider commitments, including cohort creation and cached bulk upload file deletion, while integrating with various internal APIs and external services for caching and object storage.

systems.name: Employer Commitments
systems.description: This system appears to manage commitments related to apprenticeships, interacting with multiple APIs for approvals, permissions, and commitments management, and caches data using Redis.
capabilities: API communication with Approvals, Permissions, and Commitments systems

systems.name: Provider Apprenticeships Service
systems.description: This system manages information about providers, apprenticeships, and users, including notification and subscription settings. It supports interactions with external APIs, databases, and message brokers.
capabilities: Publish and consume messages via NServiceBus

systems.name: Find An Apprenticeship Web
systems.description: This system appears to provide functionality for users to discover, apply for, and manage apprenticeship opportunities, along with features for candidate profile creation and application submission. It interacts with external APIs and services for data caching, authentication, and additional services.

systems.name: Digital Certification
systems.description: Manages digital certificates for users, including sharing, authorization, and user actions. It integrates with a SQL Server database for data storage and retrieval.

systems.name: Digital Certification
systems.description: This system manages digital certificates, including creation, sharing, and printing functionalities. It interacts with external services such as Redis for caching, Azure Blob Storage for object storage, and an internal Digital Certificates API.

systems.name: Employer Finance
systems.description: This system manages financial operations related to employer accounts, including levy declarations, payments, account transfers, and English fraction calculations. It integrates with external APIs such as Apprenticeship Levy, Commitments V2, and Content API, and utilizes SQL Server for data storage.

systems.name: Provider Payments
systems.description: This system processes provider payments and manages related events during collection periods and job submissions. It interacts with SQL Server databases for data storage and retrieval.
capabilities: Process submission job success and failures

systems.name: Das Payments V2 Common
systems.description: This system appears to define and handle common messaging commands, events, and enums related to apprenticeship payments and funding models. It interacts with a SQL Server database to perform read and write operations.

systems.name: Apprentice Commitments
systems.description: Manages apprentice registrations, apprenticeship details, and revisions, supporting processes such as confirmations and updates. It interacts with Azure Service Bus and SQL Server for messaging and data storage.
capabilities: Messaging integration via Azure Service Bus

systems.name: Apprentice Commitments
systems.description: This system appears to facilitate managing apprenticeships, including delivery models and roles and responsibilities. It integrates with Redis for caching and Azure Table Storage for operations related to data storage.
capabilities: Utilize Azure Table Storage for cloud-based data storage

systems.name: Apprentice Accounts Web
systems.description: This system appears to manage apprentice-related preferences and configuration settings, possibly supporting web-based interaction and caching functionalities.

systems.name: Apprentice Portal
systems.description: A web application that interacts with Redis for caching and Azure Table Storage for configuration management. Further specific functionality cannot be determined from the evidence supplied.
capabilities: Configuration management with Azure Table Storage

systems.name: Admin Roatp
systems.description: The system appears to manage and update information related to training providers, courses, and their restrictions, with outbound dependencies on Redis for caching and an internal Outer API for additional operations.
